name: Tidepaw · Gremlet #13
description:
A river otter that carries its favourite pebble and shows it to everyone it meets.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Tidepaw in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
